articles.title: A 194-country analysis reveals gaps in how late childhood vaccinations are tracked

articles.title: Trump Goon’s Stunning Favor to Corporate Giant Exposed
articles.description: The White House Donald Trump’s hand-picked EPA administrator oversaw a process that let chemical giant Bayer choose its own regulatory framework for a controversial weedkiller. The documents, from May and June of 2025, show that the EPA asked Bayer what they wanted, got a response, and then used that to draft the regulations. Read more at The Daily Beast.
